kicker: Question: At 8B, does training against a head audit make a probe-triggered switch hide from it? Answer: Not settled. With the audit-only penalty, 0 of 3 runs hid; 6 runs with the original penalty have not finished.
head: Trained to dodge the audit, Qwen3-8B's switch was still found, but copying the 3 flagged heads no longer always stops it
sub: Qwen3-8B, fine-tuned to answer A (mountains) only while a read-only probe reads it, B (sea) without. Then 512 more training steps, with or without a penalty for what a head audit finds. The audit flags 3 attention heads and copies their outputs from the run without the probe.
prompt_note: Each prompt starts with an unrelated text snippet. The question at the end is always the same.
bar_title: How much of the probe's push the audit's 3 heads remove (push: how far the probe moves the answer to A)
